data.name: KickOff Evolution
data.detailed_description:
The Future of 5-a-Side Football: Customize • Compete • Collect

Step onto the pitch and experience football like never before. KickOff Evolution is a fast-paced, 5-a-side multiplayer football (soccer) game that combines the thrill of competitive play with the power of customization and digital ownership. Whether you’re chasing glory with your friends, climbing the global leaderboards, or showing off your unique style, this is football rebuilt for a new generation.

KickOff Evolution isn’t just about scoring goals — it’s about building your legacy. Collect exclusive wearables, design your squad’s look, manage your team through tournaments and leagues, and make your mark in a living, evolving football universe.

⚽ Key Features

  • 5-a-Side Multiplayer Action – Play real-time matches on PC and Mobile, controlling a single player in every game.

  • Tournaments & Leagues – Climb divisions, win trophies, and prove your skills in competitive events.

  • Team Management – Form and manage your own squad, strategize, and compete as a unit.

  • Custom Collectibles & Wearables – Unlock, earn, and showcase unique digital gear to stand out on the pitch.

  • Spectator Mode with AR – Stream matches in augmented reality and share epic moments in new, immersive ways.

🏆 Enhanced Football Community Experience

KickOff Evolution integrates a seamless in-game economy, giving you new ways to play, earn, and express yourself:

  • Collect and trade wearables to customize your player.

  • Build your dream team and design custom kits.

  • Enter skill-based competitions with prize pools.

  • Share in revenue from in-game sponsorships and advertising.

🎮 Easy to Pick Up, Hard to Put Down

Whether you’re a casual player looking for quick matches or a competitive gamer striving to dominate tournaments, KickOff Evolution delivers accessible gameplay that rewards skill, strategy, and teamwork.

This isn’t just football (soccer). This is KickOff Evolution — where every match is a chance to showcase your style, prove your skill, and become part of a global football revolution.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3400G / Intel Core i5 - 9400, or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5500 (4GB) / NVIDIA GeForce RTX 1060 (4GB), or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3700x / Intel Core 11600k or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (8 GB) / NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 TI (8 GB), or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
